title.narrative: BGD Civil society support, capacity development and participation

description.narrative: The main objective of this contribution is to be able to provide timely support to primarily civil society actors in Bangladesh, in cases where regular channels of support are not possible, for organisational capacity development and support in efforts to advance dialogue, objectives and goals within identified priority areas in the Strategy for Sweden´s development cooperation with Bangladesh 20212025

Syftet med denna insats är att skapa möjlighet till direktstöd för organisationsstärkande insatser till främst civilsamhällsorganistioner i fall där reguljära finansieringavtal ej har möjlighet att hantera detta. Insatsen ska stödja aktiviteter som förstärker dialog och arbete i linje med Sveriges strategi för utvecklingssamarbetet med Bangladesh 2021­2025.

The main objective of this contribution is to be able to provide timely support to primarily civil society actors in Bangladesh, in cases where regular channels of support are not possible, for organisational capacity development and support in efforts to advance dialogue, objectives and goals within identified priority areas in the Strategy for Sweden´s development cooperation with Bangladesh 2021­2025.
Embassy supported participant attended side-events as well as the UPR hearing of Bangladesh on Nov 13, 2023, in Geneva.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
